display.description: agent: the agent display, seimei's own screen with its own keyboard and pointer (window ids are its own)

niri.agent: a nested niri on the "seimei" workspace

tools.name: niri
tools.description: Run a niri action, as `niri msg action <action> <args>` takes it. Common ones: focus-window --id N, focus-workspace <idx|name>, move-window-to-workspace --window-id N <idx|name>, close-window --id N, fullscreen-window --id N, maximize-column, set-column-width <50%|+10%>, toggle-window-floating --id N, toggle-overview, switch-layout <idx>, power-off-monitors, quit. Closing a window seimei did not open and quit wait for the user's OK on their phone.

tools.name: niri_query
tools.description: Read-only niri state as JSON (niri msg --json <what>): outputs, workspaces, windows, focused-window, focused-output, layers, keyboard-layouts or version. For details the desktop tool leaves out.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.description: Read the text on the clipboard. The user's clipboard asks them with an Approve card first (it may hold a password); with display: "agent" it reads the agent display's own clipboard, without a card.

tools.name: sway
tools.description: Run a sway command, as `swaymsg <command>` takes it (action is the command, args the rest). Common ones: [con_id=N] focus, workspace number 2, [con_id=N] move container to workspace number 3, [con_id=N] kill, [con_id=N] fullscreen toggle, [con_id=N] floating toggle, layout tabbed, input type:keyboard xkb_switch_layout 0, exit. Closing a window seimei did not open and exit wait for the user's OK on their phone.

tools.name: sway_query
tools.description: Read-only sway state as JSON: windows and workspaces (as the desktop tool sees them), outputs, inputs, the whole tree or version. For details the desktop tool leaves out.

tools.name: hyprland
tools.description: Run a Hyprland dispatcher, as `hyprctl dispatch <dispatcher> <args>` takes it (window ids are addresses: address:0x<id in hex>). Common ones: focuswindow address:0x..., workspace 2, movetoworkspacesilent 3,address:0x..., closewindow address:0x..., killactive, fullscreen 0, togglefloating address:0x..., exit. Closing a window seimei did not open and exit wait for the user's OK on their phone.

tools.name: hyprland_query
tools.description: Read-only Hyprland state as JSON (hyprctl -j <what>): clients, workspaces, monitors, activewindow, devices, layers or version. For details the desktop tool leaves out.

tools.name: x11
tools.description: Run an xdotool command, as `xdotool <command> <args>` takes it (window ids in decimal). Common ones: windowactivate N, set_desktop 1, set_desktop_for_window N 2, windowclose N, windowminimize N, windowsize N 800 600, windowmove N 0 0. Closing a window seimei did not open waits for the user's OK on their phone.

tools.name: x11_query
tools.description: Read-only X11 state as JSON: windows and workspaces (EWMH desktops, as the desktop tool sees them), outputs, or root (the window manager's EWMH properties). For details the desktop tool leaves out.

kde.agent: a headless KWin on a bus of its own, seen through screenshots only

tools.name: kde
tools.description: Run a KDE window action: activate, close, minimize, maximize, fullscreen or keep-above with a window id (and on or off to set instead of toggle), to-desktop with a window id and a desktop number or name, desktop with a number or name to switch to it, new-desktop with a name. Closing a window seimei did not open waits for the user's OK on their phone.

tools.name: kde_query
tools.description: Read-only KDE state as JSON: windows, desktops (virtual desktops) or outputs. For details the desktop tool leaves out.

gnome.agent: a headless GNOME Shell on a bus of its own, seen through screenshots only

tools.name: gnome
tools.description: Run a GNOME window action: activate, close, minimize, maximize, fullscreen or above with a window id (and on or off to set instead of toggle), to-workspace with a window id and a workspace number or name (a new name takes the empty last workspace), workspace with a number to switch to it. Closing a window seimei did not open waits for the user's OK on their phone.

tools.name: gnome_query
tools.description: Read-only GNOME state as JSON: windows, workspaces or outputs. For details the desktop tool leaves out.

tools.name: desktop
tools.description: The {wm} desktop: outputs, workspaces with their windows (id, app, title; focused, urgent, opened by seimei), the keyboard layout and whether the screen is locked (input tools refuse while it is). Start here before acting.
tools.agent: With display: "agent": the agent display's windows.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: See the screen. Without a window: the whole screen as JPEG; click and scroll take pixel coordinates from this image. With a window id: that window alone at full resolution, even on another workspace, for reading (not for click coordinates). region [x, y, w, h] (pixels of the whole-screen image) or target (bar: the status bar; top or bottom: half the screen): that part at full resolution, under 800 KB, for reading small text. It returns the image's path: Read it to see the image (only when you need to look; the path stays valid for the last 30 shots). show=true puts the image in the chat and returns the image itself.
tools.agent: With display: "agent": the agent display; a window id there is focused first{fills}.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Start an app or command in the desktop session. It runs outside seimei, so it survives seimei restarts. Its window goes to the "seimei" workspace unless workspace is "current", and counts as seimei's (closing it needs no OK). Returns the new window's id.
tools.agent: With display: "agent" it opens in the agent display instead, which starts on first use (Firefox there: use the browser tools with browser: "agent").

tools.name: agent_display
tools.description: The agent display: a screen of seimei's own ({agent}) with its own keyboard and pointer, where agent apps get input without taking the user's focus or mouse. It starts on first use by open_app or the agent browser and stops itself after a while unused, closing its apps. go: status (size, windows, memory), start or stop.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into a window: it is focused first, and typing stops if focus moves away. ASCII only; the US layout is switched on while typing.
tools.agent: With display: "agent" it types into a window of the agent display, any characters, without touching the user's focus.

tools.name: press_keys
tools.description: Press keys or combinations in a window, in order, like ["ctrl+l"], ["enter"], ["alt+tab"], ["super+shift+e"]. Names: letters, digits, punctuation, enter, esc, tab, backspace, delete, space, arrows (up/down/left/right), home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12, ctrl, shift, alt, super.
tools.agent: With display: "agent": a window of the agent display.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at pixel coordinates of the latest whole-screen screenshot. Pass the window you expect there: the click is refused if it is no longer focused. count=2 double-clicks, count=0 only moves.
tools.agent: With display: "agent": pixels of the latest agent display screenshot; the window, if given, is focused first.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll with the wheel at pixel coordinates of the latest whole-screen screenshot; positive amount scrolls down, in wheel clicks.
tools.agent: With display: "agent": pixels of the latest agent display screenshot.

tools.name: ui_tree
tools.description: Read a window's accessibility tree (AT-SPI): roles, names, states, actions and text, each with a path for ui_action. Works for GTK apps like Quod Libet; Firefox, Vesktop and kitty usually expose nothing. Use filter to keep only matching elements.

tools.name: ui_action
tools.description: Act on an element from ui_tree: run one of its actions (like click or activate), or set the text of an editable field. Works without moving the mouse or stealing focus.

tools.name: notifications
tools.description: Recent desktop notifications from mako: what is showing now and the history, newest first.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.description: Read the text on the clipboard. It asks the user with an Approve card first (it may hold a password).

tools.name: unlock_screen
tools.description: Unlock the lock screen with the password the user saved for seimei. You never see the password. Use it only when a task needs the desktop while the screen is locked.

tools.name: restore_desktop
tools.description: Bring back the desktop layout from before the last {wm} restart or reboot: apps on their workspaces, kitty windows in their folders, the user's Claude sessions resumed. Without go=true it only lists the plan; with go=true the user gets one Approve/Deny card for all of it.
